{{Quote|From Farm-Wife to Warrior is a contemporary account that I, for one, find credible.|Albegron mentions the account|<ref name="EGTWAC">{{SW|url=news/the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-part-5-zenith-of-the-republic|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 5: Zenith of the Republic}}</ref>}}
'''''From Farm-Wife to Warrior''''' was a contemporary account concerning the treatment of [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] during the [[Kymoodon Era]] by members of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. In [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]] at the Academician of Popular Studies [[Thunys Albegron]] claimed to find the account credible when speaking at the [[Conference on Popular Entertainment]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Obroa-skai/Legends|Obroa-skai]].<ref name="EGTWAC" />

==Behind the scenes==
''From Farm-Wife to Warrior'' was first mentioned in the [[2014]] fifth entry in the ''[[Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut]]'' series of posts by [[Jason Fry]] on the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars Blog|blog]]. The article featured content cut from ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' a book released in [[2012]] by Fry.
